items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: Raymond Lopez and I went to see her. Raymond did the talking. And we were, uh, ordered the job right away.

ctx.x: Down the back. Uh, then, uh, what happened when you all left for Chicago? How'd the whole business start as far as you remember?

Well, I'm positive on that because, uh, you see, we were playing on a tailgate, on a wagon. And, uh, a fella named, uh, a fella named Joe Gorham, uh, a woman dancer by the name of Myrtle Howard. And she was appearing at West End. At that time, they had a theater out there. Yeah. And she was a big-time act. So this fella asked us if we'd consider going to Chicago. Well, he just heard you the one time on the wagon? That's all. He only heard about two tunes and that was it. Uh-huh. He, we were sold. So, he made an…
Uh, he was a big-time actor. Uh, he was a big-time actor.
